# aidialog

> Read, search, edit, and persist AI dialogs stored as Jupyter notebooks

## Modules

- [aidialog.dlgskill](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/aidialog/dlgskill.html.md): Read, search, and edit dialogs and notebooks through the aidialog `Dialog`/`Message` model
- [aidialog.render](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/aidialog/render.html.md): Message and dialog rendering: one projection from `Message` to semantic fasttags, shared by every app that displays a dialog
